scope: Additional crypto/onchain sites; AI Agents is limited to crypto and Web3 agents, frameworks and agent marketplaces. General AI assistants are excluded.

methodology.discovery: DefiLlama protocol registry, Sato Hub Onchain Agents Index and targeted official-site searches. No registry trust score, TVL, or claimed audit is treated as approval.
methodology.availability: One bounded HTTPS GET of the primary site, with redirect checks, normal TLS verification, a 128 KiB response sample and a visible HTML title. No wallet connection, login, installation, paid API call or product transaction.
methodology.deduplication: Compared names, conservative name families, primary domain and final redirect domain against all 1,031 existing entries and this batch. Common second-level suffixes and hosted-app domains handled explicitly. Aliases still require reviewer confirmation.
methodology.limitations: A homepage is not a product test, security audit, official ownership verification or proof of continued operation. All candidates require the existing independent review process. Unknown metadata remains n/a or Metaverse under directory policy.
methodology.approval: No candidates are accepted, imported, marked verified or added to public site/data/projects.json by this batch.
